title: Understanding Your CloudDash Invoice
content:
CloudDash invoices are generated at the start of your billing cycle (monthly or annually) and are charged automatically to your payment method on file. This guide explains the components of your invoice.

## How to Access Your Invoices

1. Navigate to **Settings → Billing**.
2. Scroll down to the **Invoice History** section.
3. Click **Download PDF** or **View Receipt** next to any invoice.

## Invoice Components

### 1. Subscription Charge

This is the base cost for your chosen plan (Starter or Pro) for the upcoming billing period. It is billed in advance.
- Example: `CloudDash Pro - Monthly (May 1 - May 31)`

### 2. Prorated Charges (if applicable)

If you upgraded your plan during the previous billing cycle, you will see a prorated line item for the time spent on the higher tier.
- Example: `Remaining time on Pro after upgrade (Apr 15 - Apr 30)`

### 3. Credits (if applicable)

If you have a positive account balance (from a previous annual downgrade or promotional credit), it will be applied automatically and shown as a negative line item.
- Example: `Promotional Credit Applied`

### 4. Taxes (VAT / GST / Sales Tax)

CloudDash is required to collect taxes based on your billing address. The tax rate applied will be itemised clearly. If your company is tax-exempt, see the 'Tax Exemption' section below.

## Why is my invoice higher than expected?

The most common reasons for a higher-than-expected invoice are:
- You upgraded mid-month, and the invoice includes the prorated difference for last month plus the full charge for the new month.
- A promotional discount expired.
- Local tax rates changed.

CloudDash does not charge overage fees for metrics or api calls; if you hit your plan limits, data is simply dropped or rate-limited. Therefore, you will never see unexpected usage-based spikes on your invoice.

## Adding Tax Exemption (VAT / GST)

If your business is registered for VAT or GST, you can add your tax ID to remove tax from future invoices.

1. Go to **Settings → Billing**.
2. Click **Update Billing Details**.
3. Enter your VAT/Tax ID in the provided field.
4. Save changes. Tax will be excluded from the next generated invoice. We cannot retroactively remove tax from already-paid invoices.
